profile.description: This bot generates or combines images based on a given prompt and up to two images. To request an image, encapsulate the subject(s) in the prompt with <| and |> tags. For example, to create an image of a specific cat wearing a specific hat, input: "<|cat|> wearing a <|hat|>" while attaching the cat image as the first file and the hat image as the second. You can provide a maximum of two subjects, and the bot will blend them into a cohesive visual creation.
